question: Where can I locate restaurant within 110 kilometers when heading toward Cal Aggie Flying Farmers, Davis, CA starting at John Natsoulas Gallery, Davis, CA?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-121.740978 38.54212)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-121.788421 38.532932)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'restaurant'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-121.740978 38.54212)',4326)::geography, 110000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-121.740978 38.54212)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);
